text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the shopping district
with
Bamboo Memory when she
suddenly stops to look
around.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Th-this is it! ...No doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is the shopping district from a
school-life
drama I used to watch with
my dad!
choice_data_list: どうしたんだ？
どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: What's the matter?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I never noticed it was so
close to
the academy! Ah, I guess they
probably changed
out all the signs and
stuff for filming!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See the traditional Japanese sweets
shop over
there? That's where the main
character and the
rival gang leader meet
for the first time! Oh! And
over there's
where they have their final battle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This is bringing back so many
memories! I
wanna look around some
more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, a hyped-up Bamboo Memory
takes me on
an unexpected tour of the
locations from the
show she likes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is great! All the memories from
when I
used to watch the show are
flooding back to me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it's about time we head
back to the
academy! But I'd love to
come back here every
now and then.
choice_data_list: 楽しかったならよかった！
choice_data_list_en: I'm glad you had fun!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with you guys?! L-let me
through!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What's the meaning of this?!
Fighting is not
the answer!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
Agh! B-Bamboo! These people just
started
bothering me out of nowhere,
and—

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya talkin' about?! You're the one

trespassin' on our turf like you own the
place!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I got a better idea. How 'bout you shut
your
mouth?! Gotta problem with that?!

Damn Goody Two-shoes, thinkin' you
can look
down on us...
choice_data_list: 君たち、ちょっと落ち着いて……
貴方たち、ちょっと落ち着いて……
choice_data_list_en: You guys, calm down a second...
Calm down a second, you guys...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What?! Of course I have a problem! I have several words to say to all of y—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
They haven't seen anything yet! Wait till
you see
me swing to the finish with just
one hand!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
I almost let myself get out of hand
again...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But, discipline must be uph—no! I'm
getting out of
control... Ugh! What
should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then it hits me. This seems like a
situation
straight out of that show she
likes so much!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That show? Ah! That's right!
choice_data_list: ドラマの展開に解決のヒントはないか？
ドラマの展開に解決のヒントはないかな？
choice_data_list_en: Could there be a clue to solving this in the drama's plot?
I wonder if there's a clue to solving this in the drama's plot?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If you've got a problem with one of
my
students, you can take it up with me!
That is, if
you've got the guts!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What'd you just say to me?! You got any
idea who
you're talkin' to?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh! If you don't like it, why don't you
come over
here and tell it to my face?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... It's no use... We can't beat students from the academy in a race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you say that, but it looks like
you've still
got some energy left in you!
Or am I wrong about
you?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What'd you say?! Damn it! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Delinquents
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... What a run! Ooh, that's refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Y-you've been dragging us all over the
place! I
don't care if you call that
refreshing or whatever,
but I don't give a
crap about any of this anymore!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Now you get it! Instead of
fighting, you
can just go for a run and
you'll feel right as rain!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you come down to the
academy
whenever you start seeing red!
Ask for Bamboo
Memory, the head of
the disciplinary committee!
I'll take you
on anytime!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! All right, then! I'll remember that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Thanks to you, everything
worked
out just fine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you give your all until you're left
gasping for
air, you'll definitely come to
an understanding!
Just like in the show!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. It used to always be my dad and
me
tearing ahead, and my mom would
have to stop
us. We complemented each
other well.
choice_data_list: それはよかった……
choice_data_list_en: That's a relief...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And now, you're the one who stops me
when I
need it. Funny how things pan
out! Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And now, you're the one who stops me
when I
need it. Funny how things pan
out! Hehehe...

You've grown into an even more admirable Disciplinary Committee Chair, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You bet we do! And while we're here,
let's shout
at the sunset together! It'll be
just like another
scene from the show!

You've grown into an even more admirable Disciplinary Committee Chair, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You and me! When we're together, we're
the
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we both yell passionately at the
sunset
until our voices start to go.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What?! Even if I could, I wouldn't want
that!
Everything is way more exciting
when you're with
me! I'm happiest with
you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're always gonna be together!
Always! And
that's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with that reassurance from
Bamboo
Memory, we bump our fists
together passionately
in a vow of
friendship.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you think so? Well, I guess I was
able to
connect with those
troublemakers!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I've got to keep working hard! I want
to keep
growing as both the head of the
disciplinary
committee and as a person...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to go beyond being just the
committee
chair! I'll become the lord of
all discipline! That's
my new goal!
